template_threshold_side.description: The side of its threshold a template mark lies on, nearer than the bound, where a self-check of record stop needs it (record_template_near_threshold's side; #463 RM-1, since 0.12.72).

passes.description: The check needs the mark to pass, and its score lies at or above its threshold by less than the bound.

misses.description: The check needs the mark not to pass, and its score lies below its threshold by less than the bound.

ready_warning.description: A warning of record ready, never blocking (#463 S2-1).

press_point_only.description: A step's press is a single recorded point with no press region set: the package would press that exact pixel.

ready_source.description: Where a part of the package's identity (its game, server or locale) that record ready answers with came from, as record stop takes it, in sources (#463 S2-1b).

command_line.description: The command line of record ready or record stop: --game, --server (actinglab's global options) or --locale.

recording.description: What the recording holds: given at record start, or, on a stopped recording marked again, what its package was generated with.

lab_config.description: The Lab's instance configuration: the instance's game or server in actinglab's own configuration (game and server only).

installation_config.description: The configuration of the installation the program runs from: the instance's row of policy.facts.instances (game and server only).

ready_check_stop.description: Why a self-check record ready ran stopped at a failure short of its end, so that the failures missing lists of it may not be all it has, in checks[].reason (#463 S2-1c).

whole_package.description: The check judges the generated package as one, in stages each built on the one before (admission, final_package): its first refusal leaves no stage after it to judge.

check_error.description: The check met an error that is none of its verdicts (a target the evaluator cannot evaluate, a stored frame it cannot decode): what it would judge after it is not judged.

regression_verdict.description: The verdict of one regression case, as the reader and runner of contracts/resource-regression-case.md answer it in verdict (#463 RC-1).

passed.description: Every check of the case ran and passed.

failed.description: A check of the case failed: the reader's, the scene's, the package's or an expectation's.

partial.description: What ran passed, and a check did not run.

not_run.description: Nothing ran: the case is of another schema, or no expectation of it could be evaluated.

regression_result.description: The result of one check of a regression case, in its checks[].result (#463 RC-1).

failed.description: The check did not hold; its problem says why.

not_run.description: The check was not run; its reason says why.

regression_problem.description: Why a check of a regression case failed, in its checks[].problem (#463 RC-1): one word per cause.

case_missing.description: The case's directory holds no case.json that can be read as a file.

member_missing.description: A member the contract requires is absent.

member_unknown.description: A member the contract does not list for this object.

member_invalid.description: A member of the wrong type, or out of its form.

scene_missing.description: The scene file the case names is not there or cannot be read.

scene_unreadable.description: The scene's bytes are no PNG image that decodes.

scene_sha256_mismatch.description: The SHA-256 of the scene's bytes is not scene_construction.scene_sha256.

canvas_size_mismatch.description: The scene's size is not the canvas's.

scene_size_unsupported.description: The scene cannot be brought to its package's coordinate space as the offline commands bring a stored image there (they refuse it lab_scene_size_unsupported).

scene_gate_unreadable.description: Fix round 1: the kernel's frame gate for a Lab frame could not read the scene at all (no size of it is refused: the offline commands relay it as a device error).

rect_outside_canvas.description: A rectangle of scene_construction.rects does not lie inside the canvas.

package_missing.description: The case's package is no directory.

package_refused.description: The kernel's admission refused the package, or it gives no evaluator or page set.

package_id_mismatch.description: Fix round 1: the case's package_id is not the one its package's control declares.

page_conflict.description: Several pages of the package matched the scene.

page_mismatch.description: The kernel recognised another page, or none, than the case expects.

page_detection_refused.description: The kernel's page detection refused the scene for another cause than a conflict.

target_mismatch.description: The kernel's evaluation of a target is not the passed the case expects.

target_click_only.description: The target is click-only, which is never evaluated on a scene.

target_refused.description: The kernel refused evaluating the target (one the package does not declare, for one).

regression_not_run.description: Why a check of a regression case did not run, in its checks[].reason (#463 RC-1).

not_evaluated.description: This version of the runner reads the expectation and does not evaluate it.

ocr_unavailable.description: Evaluating it needs text recognition, and the Lab has no OCR model.

frames_required.description: The package's target consensus reads more frames than the case's one scene.

device_category.description: The category of a device failure.

install_source.description: Which resolver rung found the MuMu installation.

count_kind.description: What a MuMu resolution count counts.

configured_adb_class.description: The class of the configured adb.

command.description: A program command or control request. Each Runtime slice adds the commands it reports.

held_check.description: Checking that the new owner is held.

owner_probe_state.description: What the operating system reported about a recorded owner process.

running.description: A process with the recorded id runs.

not_running.description: No process with the recorded id runs.

unknown.description: The operating system did not decide.

transport_kind.description: The kind of HTTP transport failure. Its tokens are registered with the first emitter.

disposition.description: Which side must act on a refusal.

device.description: The device or emulator must change.

uncertain.description: The result is unknown; check the state before trying again.

selection_state.description: The state of the installation selection.

root_tools_state.description: The state of the root Tools.

runtime_state.description: The state of the Runtime process.

not_terminated.description: Asked to stop, but not confirmed terminated.

agent_delivery_state.description: The state of one wake's delivery (Workflow #432 AGT-1b).

prepared.description: Body written, row recorded, no send tried.

deferred.description: No write happened; the target is unavailable.

sending.description: Intent committed; one write may be under way.

delivered.description: A client wrote or acknowledged. Delivery is not completion.

failed.description: Certainly no write, or a definite refusal.

unknown.description: A write may have happened; never sent again.

body_failed.description: The body could not be written.

agent_delivery_problem.description: What went wrong with a delivery: the transports' neutral problems and the worker's own (Workflow #432 AGT-1b).

protocol_changed.description: A client's private protocol is not what this build knows.

rejected.description: The client definitely refused the message.

owner_mismatch.description: The channel's address is served by another process than its session.

write_timed_out.description: The write did not finish within its deadline.

receipt_mismatch.description: A receipt does not match the message.

channel_unknown.description: The readable registry does not list the channel.

message_too_long.description: The message cannot hold its header, kind word and path within agent_wake.summary.max_chars.

interrupted_by_stop.description: A restart found the wake in sending.

intent_refused.description: The intent could not be committed, so nothing was written.

wake_queue_full.description: The bounded queue was full and candidates were dropped.

kind_unknown.description: A row names a kind this build has no word for.

body_unwritable.description: The body file could not be written or does not fit its bound.

detail_unwritable.description: The delivery detail file could not be written; the delivery goes on.

sweep_failed.description: The retention sweep could not read or remove a file.

quiet_unreadable.description: The quiet windows could not be judged.

worker_panicked.description: The worker's iteration panicked; it backs off and goes on.

worker_spawn_failed.description: The worker thread could not start; the feature is off until the next start.

local_time_unknown.description: The host's local day could not be read, so the day caps could not be judged; the waiting candidates stay queued (Workflow #432 AGT-2).

file_state.description: The state of one file in an integrity check.

device_stage.description: The stage of a device failure. Its tokens are registered with the device codes.

device_backend.description: A capture or input backend. Its tokens are registered with the device codes.

mumu_root_source.description: How the MuMu folder was given or found.

env.description: The folder environment variable names it.

mcp_blocker.description: What must change before an MCP call can work.

server_tier.description: The server's tier must include the tool's tier.

install_root.description: The installation root must be known.

tools_dir.description: The root Tools folder must be known.

material_mode.description: The material mode must allow it.

state_root.description: The Runtime state root must be known (--state-root, or the configuration's state_root).

runtime_upgrade.description: actingd must be a release that serves the request.

input.description: An input field on a page or the command line.

invocation.description: Which entry of a program was invoked.

action.description: An action a run did or plans to do.

control.description: How a Runtime is closed or started.

cold.description: Cold: a shutdown request or a plain start.

language.description: A display language (a BCP 47 language tag).

dir.description: A program folder of an installation.

party_source.description: Where a party's interface ranges come from.

fate.description: What a real run does with an entry under the root.

root_tools_rule.description: Handled by the root Tools rule.

directml.description: DirectML on one DXGI adapter (Workflow #407 GPU-1).

gpu_unavailable_reason.description: Why the configured GPU execution provider cannot be used: the value of vision_gpu_unavailable (Workflow #407 GPU-1 A, design rd-1031/perf-407/design-gpu1.md sections 1.3, 2.3 and 2.5).

adapter_missing.description: No DXGI adapter has the configured identity, or the adapters cannot be listed.

adapter_ambiguous.description: Two or more physical adapters have the configured identity, and their PCI locations do not single one out.

adapter_not_physical.description: Adapters have the configured identity, but each is an indirect-display, software or paravirtualized copy, or its kernel adapter type could not be read.

directml_library_missing.description: The vision root's ort\DirectML.dll is missing.

directml_library_mismatch.description: The vision root's ort\DirectML.dll differs from the runtime pin.

provider_register_failed.description: ONNX Runtime refused to register the DirectML execution provider (no driver, no Direct3D 12 device, not enough memory).

session_build_failed.description: ONNX Runtime could not build a session on the DirectML execution provider.

placement_unread.description: The node placement of a DirectML session could not be read in full.

inference_failed.description: ONNX Runtime's run of a DirectML session failed (the device was removed or reset); the model is built again, and when the first run after that fails too, the model runs on the CPU (Workflow #407 GPU-1 E).

gpu_fallback.description: What the process does when the configured GPU execution provider cannot be used: the value of vision.gpu_fallback, cpu when absent (Workflow #407 GPU-1 A, design rd-1031/perf-407/design-gpu1.md sections 1.2 and 2.3).

cpu.description: The model runs on the CPU, with one warning.

refuse.description: OCR requests fail as they did before the fallback existed.

present.description: Which of two paired items is present.

record.description: The record a value is checked against.

section.description: A section of a vision manifest.

side.description: Which side of a decision stopped waiting.

unproved_by.description: Why a release order could not be proved.

installed_record_unreadable.description: The installed record cannot be read.

installed_record_orphaned.description: An installed record exists without an installation.

installed_time_missing.description: The installed release has no publication time.

candidate_time_missing.description: The candidate release has no publication time.

emulator_restart_phase.description: The phase of an emulator restart.

emulator_watch_kind.description: What the emulator watch asked of an instance's emulator (EMU-BIND, since 0.12.28).

restart.description: The start of a configured instance's stopped emulator (R3).

recognize.description: The recognition of a running emulator whose endpoint the Runtime holds pending or bound to another port (since 0.12.28 also bound to the reported port but never prepared on it): the reported port bound and the instance self-checked, nothing started or stopped.

emulator_autostart_skip_reason.description: Why no autostart claim was requested for an instance where one would otherwise have been (WATCH-P, since 0.12.32: the emulator watch's restart or recognition; PAUSE-AUTO, since 0.12.34: the configured start at daemon start and IDLE-1's wake after stop_emulator, or why such a claim ended on its key without a Start).

instance_paused.description: The instance's own scheduling pause holds it, in any stage (draining, paused, released; Alice's ruling 112): the watch reads and records its emulator status but neither restarts nor recognizes it. Recorded once per pause revision and watch_kind. PAUSE-AUTO (since 0.12.34, Alice's ruling 117 A): neither the configured start at daemon start nor IDLE-1's wake after stop_emulator starts its emulator, also when their claim was requested before the pause began, and neither does a restart or recognition claim the watch requested before the pause began (nor does it take a place in the watch's bound); recorded once per pause revision and start.

player_held.description: The instance's player hold holds it, in any phase (Workflow #429 R-7a; R-7b first answers it): first before the instance's own pause (R-7a section 2.6). Recorded once per reason and revision.

global_paused.description: The global scheduling pause holds it, a restored one included, and the instance carries no pause of its own (#480 PG-1, since 0.12.72; the owner's requirement on board #480: after pause all the Runtime starts no emulator by itself): the watch neither restarts nor recognizes it, neither the configured start at daemon start nor IDLE-1's wake after stop_emulator starts its emulator, and a claim of any of them requested before the pause ends on its key without a Start (the watch's taking no place in its bound, an idle wake's owed again). Recorded once per global pause revision, start and instance. Where the instance's own pause holds it too, instance_paused is recorded instead.

start_emulator_off.description: The instance's start_emulator in effect is off (#429 R-3, since 0.12.39): an autostart claim requested while it was on (the daemon start's, an IDLE-1 wake's, the emulator watch's restart) met it off on its key and released the key without a Start (the watch's request taking no place in its bound), or IDLE-1's wake after stop_emulator found it off and requested no claim: the wake ends without a Start and the instance is no longer kept closed. Recorded once per claim or wake.

instance_pause_stage.description: The stage of an instance pause (contracts/scheduling-pause.md "Instance pause: three stages"), the value pause_stage of scheduling_pause_standing, scheduling_pause_kept_at_shutdown and scheduling_pause_lifted_by_resume (#480 PG-2c, since 0.12.73).

draining.description: Stage (a) and (b): the gate is closed and the instance's contained runs are drained.

paused.description: Stage (c): no run of the instance is in flight, and the pause waits until nothing uses the device and hands it back.

released.description: The device is handed back: nothing uses it while the gate is closed.

pause_obstacle.description: What was still in the way of an instance pause's stages, the items of in_the_way of scheduling_pause_standing, each read from the host's own state at that moment (#480 PG-2c, since 0.12.73; contracts/scheduling-pause.md "Two modes").

contained_run.description: A contained run of the instance is still in flight (a client's, a policy dispatch's or a package the host started itself); past the drain it was asked to stop at its next checkpoint.

policy_run.description: A policy run the instance's worker still holds, from its hand-off to its settlement.

lease.description: A lease of another party holds the instance (a client's lease, a direct run, an operator's control, a Lab operation, a self-check).

automatic_start.description: The Runtime's own automatic emulator start: its claim holds the instance's key, or its Start was committed before the pause was recorded.

recovery_ladder.description: The Runtime's own stuck-recovery ladder holds the instance's key.

queued_entry.description: An entry queued for the instance that the pause does not hold back (a client's or an operator's claim).

client_reset.description: A client owes the instance its reset after a run of its ended cancelled.

close_refused.description: Outside the multi-Nemu gate, the dedicated lease of the session close was refused (another member's entry ahead, a takeover cooldown, a holder); the close is tried again.

close_unconfirmed.description: Outside the multi-Nemu gate, the session close could not be confirmed and fenced the instance; it is not tried again: a person's resume reconnects the instance.

check_failed.description: The last check of the pause's stages failed with a failure that is not fatal; it is tried again (#480 PG-2c fix round 1).

emulator_stop_result.description: How the Stop phase of an emulator restart ended: confirmed, or the token the host's stop-result table gives the stage the Stop failed at.

control.description: The Stop failed without a device diagnostic, at the default control stage (mumu_manager_control).

control_errcode.description: The shutdown command answered an errcode envelope with errcode not 0 (mumu_manager_control_errcode).

wait_timeout.description: The readiness wait for the stopped state expired (mumu_manager_wait_timeout).

run.description: MuMuManager could not be started, or a poll could not run (mumu_manager_run).

timeout.description: The shutdown command passed its bound (mumu_manager_timeout).

path.description: The MuMuManager path is not valid UTF-8 (mumu_manager_path).

errcode.description: An info poll answered an errcode envelope (mumu_manager_errcode).

entry.description: An info poll's instance entry carried an errcode envelope (mumu_manager_entry).

shape.description: An info poll answered an unexpected shape (mumu_manager_shape).

decode.description: An info poll's output is not UTF-8 (mumu_manager_decode).

json.description: An info poll's output is not JSON (mumu_manager_json).

output_bound.description: An info poll's output passed its bound (mumu_manager_output_bound).

unavailable.description: The instance has no MuMuManager binding (emulator_control_binding).

unsupported.description: The provider has no instance control (emulator_control_support).

unregistered.description: The instance is not registered with the provider (emulator_control_registration).

device_process_presence.description: Whether a vendor device process of an emulator instance was still running when a Stop's process listing last looked.

true.description: The last listing still showed the device process.

false.description: The last listing showed no device process of the instance.

unknown.description: No listing answered: it failed, passed its bound or never ran.

capture_open_cause.description: Why opening an instance's capture backend failed, as far as the backend can tell (#411 A50).

display_missing.description: The display of the instance's application package does not exist: the application is not running (a Nemu display lookup by package answered no display). Since 0.12.40 (#402 HS-5a) no paired session reports it: one without its package's display takes the main display.

connection_failed.description: The connection to the emulator instance failed (a Nemu connect answered no handle).

other.description: Any other failure, or a backend that cannot tell the causes apart; the backend's own text is the raw_text of the outcome's foreign link.

ledger_source.description: A revisioned source whose changes the ledger records (Workflow #383).

runtime_facts.description: The scheduler workbench's runtime fact store.

segment_edge.description: The edge of a reported stretch of a condition.

channel.description: The channel a Runtime connection is bound to: one of the general interface's three counters, or the Lab channel (Workflow #389).

cli.description: actingctl, and the installer and scripts that run it.

lab_option.description: One of the two Lab options of the installer page (Workflow #389).

pacing_stage.description: A performance pacing stage of an instance (Workflow #385): s0 is normal pacing, each later stage a worse responsiveness band.

s1.description: First signs: longer intervals and one more retry, never a pause.

s2.description: Tight: longer intervals and more retries, never a pause.

s3.description: Short: dispatch shares fall and the instances with the smallest share pause first.

s4.description: Severe: every dispatch pauses and running policy runs are held.

blackout_source.description: Where a blackout comes from (Workflow #386 SR-4a1, SCH-M section 3.2 D-1): the configuration list a refused entry is in, or the source of the entry a blackout judgement reports.

host.description: The machine-wide list scheduling.blackout.host; it covers every instance.

instance.description: The instance's own list instance.<instance id>.scheduling.blackout; it covers that instance only.

catalog.description: A maintenance event of the active catalog's timeline whose scope matches the instance.

ladder_class.description: How the recovery ladder's trigger matching reads a code (Workflow #387). Every code entry names exactly one class: the first of these tokens, in this order, whose rule the code meets.

planned_stop.description: 1. Planned stop: a person, a rule or the pack's design stopped the run on purpose (a cancel, a pause, a performance yield or hold, a blackout window, a locked feature).

budget_or_permission.description: 2. Budget or permission: the work lacked time, samples, attempts, quota or permission (a sampling deadline, an insufficient sample budget, a run timeout, an exhausted policy budget).

declaration_error.description: 3. Declaration error: a pack, a binding or a configuration the work uses is itself wrong or incompatible; decided without looking at the screen, the same on every run.

pack_logic_mismatch.description: 4. Pack logic mismatch: the screen or the flow differs from what the pack declares; known only by looking at the screen (an unknown page, a failed or conflicting recognition, an unconfirmed step, an error page, an unmatched entry).

environment_fault.description: 5. Environment fault: a device, a backend, ADB, the emulator or the vision provider could not open or failed, and the work ended because of it.

stability_warning.description: 6. Stability warning: a device, connection, capture or input anomaly on one instance that the Runtime retried or survived; its category is warning or error. Repeated, it shows the environment getting worse.

none.description: 7. Not applicable: a success or an info, a Runtime-internal invariant, a refused request or contract value, a client error or a configuration error.

device_state_probe.description: A device-state read of a handset (model-398 section 7.1).

keyguard.description: dumpsys window policy: the keyguard section.

home.description: cmd package resolve-activity for the home intent.

settings.description: settings get of a screen-timeout setting.

device_config_problem.description: What is wrong with an instance's device declaration (model-398 section 10.1).

kind_unknown.description: device.kind is neither emulator nor handset.

transport_unsupported.description: device.transport is not usb on a handset (tcp is reserved), or is named on an emulator.

endpoint_with_handset.description: A handset names host, port or connect.

serial_in_config.description: A handset names serial: its serial lives only in the private binding file.

discovery_key_with_handset.description: A handset names instance_index, instance_name or nemu_app_index.

backend_kind_unsupported.description: The instance selects a backend its device kind does not allow, or (Workflow #479 F-2) any backend on an iOS handset, which has none in this build.

alias_too_long.description: A handset's alias is longer than 248 bytes, so its label would not fit a name.

system_unsupported.description: device.system is neither android nor ios, or is named beside a kind other than handset (Workflow #479 F-2).

adb_member_with_ios.description: An iOS handset names a member only a device reached through adb has: adb_path, command_timeout_ms or a touch tool's member (maatouch_local_path, minitouch_local_path, push_touch_tool, handshake_timeout_ms, shutdown_timeout_ms, tap_hold_ms); refused, never ignored (Workflow #479 F-2 fix round 1).

device_binding_problem.description: What is wrong with the private device-binding file (model-398 section 10.1).

unreadable.description: The file exists but cannot be read as a file.

malformed.description: The file is not JSON of the file's shape and schema, is larger than its bound, or names an alias no instance could have.

duplicate_alias.description: Two bindings name the same alias.

duplicate_serial.description: Two bindings name the same device (two Android rows of one serial, or, Workflow #479 F-2, two iOS rows of one device key): one device is bound to one instance only.

serial_invalid.description: A serial is not 1 to 64 bytes of printable ASCII without white space.

device_key_invalid.description: An iOS row's device_key is not sha256: and 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits (Workflow #479 F-2).

system_mismatch.description: The row of a handset's alias is of another device system than the handset's configuration names: an iOS row for an Android handset, or the reverse (Workflow #479 F-2).

device_link_state.description: The state of a handset's wired device link (model-398 section 4.2). The first six are what the adb server reports for the bound serial; the last two are the Runtime's own.

device.description: adb reports device: the handset answers.

absent.description: The bound serial is not in adb's device list (the cable is out).

unauthorized.description: adb reports unauthorized: a person allows USB debugging on the handset.

no_permissions.description: adb reports no permissions (a driver problem on the host).

other.description: adb reports another state (authorizing, connecting, recovery, sideload, bootloader and the like).

unwatched.description: The link watch is not running, so the Runtime cannot see the link.

unbound.description: The private binding file binds no device to the handset instance.

ios_list_problem.description: Why acib, the project's iOS device bridge, gave no list of iOS phones: one of acib's own words for acib devices, or one of the Lab's (three; fix round 1's three: the Lab calls acib with a deadline, waits for it a little longer, reads a bounded amount of its output and ends it past either; and fix round 2's one, a state of the child that could not be read, each word one cause) (Workflow #479 F-2, contracts/device-binding.md, An iOS handset). A listing says it in its member ios_devices_unlisted and answers its Android rows; an iOS bind is refused device_ios_list_failed with it.

not_installed.description: acib is not installed: no file at the install root's tools\acib.exe.

not_started.description: The file is there but the system could not start it.

answer_unreadable.description: acib ran but its line is not one of its devices answers (no line, a line its output could not be read for, not JSON of its shape, or a word of none of these).

command_line_invalid.description: acib's word: its command line was refused.

async_runtime_failed.description: acib's word: its asynchronous runtime could not start.

deadline_passed.description: acib's word: its listing did not finish within its deadline.

usbmuxd_unreachable.description: acib's word: Apple's device service (usbmuxd) does not answer.

usbmuxd_list_failed.description: acib's word: usbmuxd answered but its device list could not be read.

key_salt_unusable.description: acib's word: the salt it was given for the keys is unusable.

binding_salt_unusable.description: acib's word: the salt it was given for the binding keys is unusable.

no_answer_in_time.description: acib had not ended with its answer when the Lab's wait (12 s, a little above the 10 s deadline the Lab gives it, --timeout-ms) passed; the Lab ended it (Workflow #479 F-2 fix round 1).

answer_too_long.description: acib printed more than the Lab reads of one of its streams (64 KiB of its output or of its errors); the Lab ended it (Workflow #479 F-2 fix round 1).

not_ended.description: The Lab asked acib to end (past its wait, past its cap, or after a stream or its state could not be read) and ending it failed: it may still run (Workflow #479 F-2 fix round 1; fix round 2: this cause alone).

state_unreadable.description: The Lab could not read whether acib had ended, so it ended it, and ending it succeeded: it runs no more, and what it answered is not known (Workflow #479 F-2 fix round 2).

device_row_problem.description: Why a device row adb lists cannot be bound to a handset instance (#398 DB-2, contracts/device-binding.md, Choosing a device).

state_not_device.description: adb reports the row in another state than device, the state of an authorized device that is online (unauthorized, offline, no permissions, authorizing, recovery and the like).

transport_mismatch.description: The row's transport is not the one the handset instance declares (device.transport, usb when it names none): a tcp row, an emulator's loopback row among them.

system_mismatch.description: The row is a phone of another device system than the handset instance declares (device.system): an Android device's key or handle named for an iOS handset, or an iOS phone's key for an Android one (Workflow #479 F-2).

backend_switch_problem.description: Why a ConfigureSettings that names an instance's backend keys did not switch its backends (#402 HS-2, design HS-M section 3.6).

instance_busy.description: The instance was not free within the switch claim's wait (CONNECTION_PREPARATION_CLAIM_WAIT_MS): a run, even between two of its steps, a ladder, a lease, a Lab operation or another operator claim held it; the cause is lease_queue_expired with holder_kind.

player_held.description: A player holds the instance; the cause is player_hold_active.

instance_fenced.description: A #403 fence holds the instance; the cause is instance_resources_fenced. A passing self-check lifts it.

endpoint_unavailable.description: The instance's endpoint is pending (its emulator is stopped) or its handset is not bound, so no backend can open.

open_failed.description: The new backends did not open or failed their self-check; the previous backends were restored and opened again. The cause is the failing open's code.

restore_failed.description: The new backends did not open, and the previous backends did not open again either: the instance is unavailable and no other instance is touched. The causes are both failures.

nemu_app_index_problem.description: Why a paired Nemu open of an instance whose configuration names no nemu_app_index resolved none from MuMuManager's read of the application's state, control -v <index> app info -pkg <package> (#402 HS-3, design HS-M section 4.1).

package_not_installed.description: MuMuManager reports the instance's application package not installed (state not_installed).

application_not_running.description: MuMuManager reports the package installed and not running (state stopped). Since 0.12.40 (#402 HS-5b) not reported: stopped resolves index 0 as running does, and the paired session takes the main display while the application does not run.

info_unavailable.description: The read gave no answer: no MuMuManager to read through, a run that failed or passed its 10 s bound, a non-zero exit or an errcode envelope.

info_malformed.description: MuMuManager answered something other than the documented document: not UTF-8, not JSON, over the output bound, or no state among running, stopped and not_installed.

device_watch_problem.description: What went wrong with the device-link watch (model-398 section 4.3).

spawn_failed.description: The watch process could not be started.

exited.description: The watch process ended, or its output closed.

protocol_invalid.description: The watch's output has a shape the parser does not know.

restart_budget_spent.description: The watch ended more often within the restart window than the restart limit allows.

device_hold.description: What holds a handset (model-398 section 7.3 to 7.5), in the order its availability names the first of them (device_state:<hold>).

locked.description: A keyguard waits for a person (device_locked).

thermal.description: The thermal status reached the hold level (device_thermal_hold).

battery_low.description: On no power source, below the battery level (device_battery_low).

in_use.description: Another application was in the foreground at a run's start (device_in_use).

thermal_status.description: A handset's thermal status (model-398 section 7.1): Android's thermal status levels, mildest first. The device_state thermal keys take these words.

critical.description: Status 4: the platform has done everything it can to reduce power.

emergency.description: Status 5: key components are about to shut down.

shutdown.description: Status 6: the device shuts down at once.

table_mismatch.description: How a standard-pack table differs from the selection document's declaration of it (Workflow #357 DB-2, K2).

row_key.description: The file's row_key differs from the declared one.

column_absent.description: A declared column is not in the file.

column_type.description: A declared column has another type in the file.

allowed_not_subset.description: A value the document declares for an enum_string column is not allowed by the file.

standard_pack_problem.description: What is wrong with a standard-pack root file (Workflow #373 NAV-6), table file (Workflow #357 DB-1), pack's loading copy (Workflow #407 LOAD-1), bundle's notices directory (Workflow #444 NOTICES-1), the variables a game root's packages declare (Workflow #463 V1) or a game root's pack-catalog.json (Workflow #477 PC-1).

malformed.description: The file is not JSON of the file's shape and version; for a table, not canonical JSON either (a floating point number, an unsafe integer or a duplicate key).

game_mismatch.description: The file's game is not the game directory it sits in.

bundle_invalid.description: bundle.json breaks the bundle index rules.

bundle_missing.description: The game root holds interrupts.json, navigation.json, pages.json, (Workflow #392 DA-4) display-layout.json, (Workflow #357 DB-1) a tables directory or, for the readers of pack-catalog.json (Workflow #477 PC-1, since 0.12.68; before it of ui.json, Workflow #429 R-11), pack-catalog.json but no bundle.json.

pages_missing.description: The game root holds interrupts.json or navigation.json but no pages.json.

page_id_invalid.description: A page id is not 1-64 bytes of [a-z][a-z0-9_]*.

page_duplicate.description: A page id is listed twice.

pages_count.description: pages holds no page, or more than 256; in loading.json or a pack's loading copy, more than 16 (Workflow #407 LOAD-1).

features_count.description: features names no package, or more than 8.

package_not_listed.description: A named package is not a package of the game root's bundle.

server_duplicate.description: Two packages of one list belong to the same server.

schedule_invalid.description: schedule.json is not of its shape and version, or breaks one of its own rules: a scope, an instance override, an unknown server (ROUT-L RL-1a).

schedule_requires_missing.description: schedule.json requires a subsystem the Runtime does not name (ROUT-L RL-1a).

rule_package_unregistered.description: A rule or a held entry of schedule.json names a package the game root's bundle does not hold (ROUT-L RL-1a).

rule_id_conflict.description: Two rules, pools, profiles or events share an id, in one schedule.json or across the games in use, or two games' rules name one package id (ROUT-L RL-1a).

interrupt_page_unlisted.description: An interrupt's page is not a page of pages.json.

interrupt_duplicate.description: Two interrupts name the same page.

packages_count.description: An interrupt's handlers or then.run names no package, or more than 8; since Workflow #463 INT-1 (0.12.73) an empty handlers only where then is not end_run.

max_per_run_invalid.description: An interrupt's max_per_run is outside 1 to 8.

interrupt_result_invalid.description: An interrupt declares result but its then is not end_run (UPD-1, since 0.12.30).

interrupt_limit_cause_invalid.description: An interrupt that names no handler declares limit_cause, which cannot apply: such a page ends the run the first time it is met (Workflow #463 INT-1, since 0.12.73).

edges_count.description: navigation.json holds more than 1024 edges (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

edge_page_invalid.description: An edge's from or to is no page id: any, a draft's @origin or another word outside [a-z][a-z0-9_]* (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

edge_page_unlisted.description: An edge's from or to is not a page of pages.json (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

edge_self_loop.description: An edge's from and to are the same page (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

edge_duplicate.description: Two edges have the same from, to and package_id (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

recovery_chain_count.description: recovery_chain names no package, or more than 8 (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

recovery_chain_duplicate.description: recovery_chain names a package twice (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

table_id_mismatch.description: A table's table_id is not its file name without .json, or the file name is no table id (Workflow #357 DB-1).

table_column_invalid.description: A table's columns break a rule: their count (2 to 32), a name, a repeated name, a type's declaration (min and max, allowed), a second key column, or valid_until_unix_s on a column that is not nullable (Workflow #357 DB-1).

table_row_key_invalid.description: A table's row_key is empty or longer than 8, repeats a column, does not start with the key column, or names an undeclared or nullable column (Workflow #357 DB-1).

table_row_invalid.description: A table has no row, a row is not as long as columns, or a cell is not of its column's type (Workflow #357 DB-1).

table_value_out_of_range.description: A table cell is outside its column's min and max or allowed values, or is null in a column that is not nullable (Workflow #357 DB-1).

table_row_duplicate.description: Two rows of a table have the same row key (Workflow #357 DB-1).

table_too_large.description: A table holds more than 8192 rows or 2 MiB, or is a game root's 65th table or later by file name (Workflow #357 DB-1).

display_layout_invalid.description: display-layout.json breaks one of its rules: its correction.radius_px is above 64 (Workflow #392 DA-4, model 392 v1.2 section 4.1).

catalog_out_of_limits.description: pack-catalog.json is larger than 1 MiB, or one of its lists, texts, locales, words, pool ids or amounts is outside its limit, at the pointer of what exceeds: an error in the business part and of the file as a whole, a warning in the display part (Workflow #477 PC-1, since 0.12.68). It replaced ui_out_of_limits of ui.json (Workflow #429 R-11), which no program reads any more. The 0.12.71 train (Workflow #477 PC-2, since 0.12.71): standard-pack catalog refuses so, an error at its pointer, an entry it would leave out whose package_id, or a pool it would drop whose pool_id, no warning can name (over 256 bytes, or with a control character), its value not echoed.

catalog_duplicate.description: pack-catalog.json lists a package_id twice or a pool twice on one side of an entry (errors), or a group id, a risk word of one package or an aspect ratio twice (warnings), at the later one (Workflow #477 PC-1, since 0.12.68). It replaced ui_duplicate of ui.json.

catalog_pool_undeclared.description: A pool of a package's consumes or produces in pack-catalog.json is not a pool the game root's schedule.json declares, or the root has no schedule.json (an error; Workflow #477 PC-1, since 0.12.68).

catalog_group_unknown.description: A package's group in pack-catalog.json is not an id of its groups (a warning: the package shows with its id; Workflow #477 PC-1, since 0.12.68). It replaced ui_group_unknown of ui.json.

catalog_text_missing.description: A group of pack-catalog.json without title, or a package entry that writes a display member without title or summary (a warning: the package shows with its id; Workflow #477 PC-1, since 0.12.68). ui_parameter_undeclared of ui.json went with that file: the catalog has no parameters member, a package's variables carry their own texts.

catalog_group_title_differs.description: A group of the display file standard-pack catalog --displays reads has the id of a group of the catalog with another title (an error: the line adds a group that is not there and never renames one; a group of the same id and the same title, compared as JSON values without the order of its locales, is simply there; Workflow #477 PC-2 fix round 1, since 0.12.71).

loading_target_invalid.description: A target of loading.json or of a pack's loading copy has an id that is not loading/<name> or that the file declares twice, or a template target's template is not loading/<file>.png (Workflow #407 LOAD-1, since 0.12.37).

loading_page_invalid.description: A loading page's required holds no template target, or a page names a target the file does not declare (Workflow #407 LOAD-1, since 0.12.37).

loading_max_invalid.description: max_ms of loading.json or of a pack's loading copy is outside 1 to 1800000 (Workflow #407 LOAD-1, since 0.12.37).

loading_template_invalid.description: A template loading.json declares is missing, cannot be read, is no PNG or is of one colour throughout (Workflow #407 LOAD-1, since 0.12.37); LOAD-2: or so is a template a pack's loading copy reads, when the pack loader compiles it; Workflow #451 LOAD-P (since 0.12.59): or a bundle zip's loading.json declares a template the zip does not carry below loading/, refused by the installer's place with path the missing member.

loading_coordinate_mismatch.description: A pack that takes loading pages declares another coordinate_space than loading.json (Workflow #407 LOAD-1, since 0.12.37); LOAD-2: or than its loading copy, when the pack loader compiles it.

loading_page_collision.description: A pack that takes a loading page declares a page of the same id itself (Workflow #407 LOAD-1, since 0.12.37), checked by the tools and (LOAD-2) by the pack loader.

loading_target_collision.description: A pack that takes a loading target declares a target of the same id itself (Workflow #407 LOAD-1, since 0.12.37), checked by the tools and (LOAD-2) by the pack loader.

loading_pack_stale.description: A pack's loading copy (resources/loading.json, resources/loading/) is not the one loading.json makes for it, or the pack carries one with no loading.json (Workflow #407 LOAD-1, since 0.12.37); LOAD-2: the pack loader also refuses a file below resources/loading/ that the copy does not read, or one without the copy, and resource validate names a stale copy with it.

notice_count.description: A bundle's notices directory holds more than 64 files; limit_count and count carry the bound and the count (Workflow #444 NOTICES-1, since 0.12.58).

notice_bytes.description: A file of a bundle's notices directory is empty or larger than 2 MiB (2097152 bytes); limit_bytes carries the bound broken, 1 or 2097152, and actual_bytes the size (Workflow #444 NOTICES-1, since 0.12.58).

notice_total_bytes.description: The files of a bundle's notices directory hold more than 8 MiB (8388608 bytes) together; limit_bytes and actual_bytes carry the bound and the total (Workflow #444 NOTICES-1, since 0.12.58).

notice_depth.description: A path lies more than two segments below a bundle's notices directory; limit_count and count carry the bound and the depth (Workflow #444 NOTICES-1, since 0.12.58).

notice_name.description: A path of a bundle's notices directory breaks the name rules: a segment that is not 1 to 64 bytes (limit_bytes and actual_bytes) of [A-Za-z0-9._-] beginning with a letter or a digit, a device name, a trailing dot, a file name suffix other than none, md, txt, tsv or csv; or two of its paths are equal under ASCII case folding, a file's path is another path's directory, two of its directories' names are equal under ASCII case folding and not byte for byte (A/x.md beside a/y.md, at the later path; NOTICES-2), or the bundle that carries it lists a pack named notices in any ASCII case (package_id) (Workflow #444 NOTICES-1, since 0.12.58).

notice_not_text.description: A file of a bundle's notices directory is not strict UTF-8, or holds a control character other than TAB, LF, FF and CR (Workflow #444 NOTICES-1, since 0.12.58).

notice_undeclared.description: A bundle carries the notices directory and declares a package interface maximum below 10 (Workflow #444 NOTICES-1, since 0.12.58; first checked by NOTICES-2).

loading_pack_name.description: A bundle zip that carries the loading templates directory loading/ lists a pack named loading in any ASCII case (package_id); placed, the two would share one folder of the game root. Refused by the installer's place at bundle.json (Workflow #451 LOAD-P, since 0.12.59).

goal_name_duplicate.description: An entry of goals.json has a name an earlier entry has, at the later name (Workflow #455 G-R1, since 0.12.60).

goal_type_unknown.description: An entry's type in goals.json is none of the types of version 1, a later version's type included (Workflow #455 G-R1, since 0.12.60); since Workflow #463 V1 the five of version 2, the four types the placement variable replaced (integer, choice, switch, ordered) included.

goal_block_mismatch.description: An entry's block in goals.json is not the block its type is shown with (Workflow #455 G-R1, since 0.12.60), or (Workflow #463 V1) a variable entry's block is not the placed variable's.

goal_pool_unknown.description: A resource entry of goals.json governs a pool that is not a pool of the composed schedule (Workflow #455 G-R1, since 0.12.60).

goal_pool_unvalued.description: A resource entry of goals.json governs a pool whose valuation has no scale and gap (Workflow #455 G-R1, since 0.12.60).

goal_package_unknown.description: An entry of goals.json governs a package that is not a package of bundle.json (Workflow #455 G-R1, since 0.12.60): since Workflow #463 V1 the package a tier entry's rule runs, or one that declares a placed variable.

goal_governs_irreversible.description: An entry of goals.json governs a package, or a tier entry a rule whose package, provides a capability that a package of the game root marks irreversible true in its control declaration's provides; no goal entry governs such a package or rule (Workflow #455 G-R1, since 0.12.60; rules and capabilities across the root since its fix round 1); nor (Workflow #463 V1) places a variable such a package declares, at the entry's name.

goal_rule_unknown.description: A tier entry of goals.json governs a rule that is not a rule of schedule.json (Workflow #455 G-R1, since 0.12.60).

goal_tier_without_fixed_value.description: A tier entry of goals.json governs a rule that writes no fixed_value_milli (Workflow #455 G-R1, since 0.12.60).

goal_range_invalid.description: What an entry of goals.json declares as its values cannot hold one: an option value written twice or a tier's scale_milli outside 1 to 1000000 (Workflow #455 G-R1, since 0.12.60; the integer, ordered and table cases went with the types Workflow #463 V1 replaced).

goal_default_invalid.description: An entry's default in goals.json is not a value of its declaration (Workflow #455 G-R1, since 0.12.60): since Workflow #463 V1 a tier's default that is none of its options.

goal_table_unknown.description: An ordered entry of goals.json takes its values from a table that is no table of the game root, or names a key its table does not hold (Workflow #455 G-R1, since 0.12.60). Workflow #463 V1 replaced the ordered entry; no entry or variable takes a table, so nothing gives this word.

goal_rate_invalid.description: A resource entry's rate in goals.json has its ceiling below its floor (Workflow #455 G-R1, since 0.12.60).

goal_out_of_limits.description: goals.json is larger than 1 MiB, or one of its lists, maps, names, option values, ids, keys, locales or texts is outside its limit, at the pointer of what exceeds (Workflow #455 G-R1 fix round 1, since 0.12.60).

goal_undeclared.description: A bundle zip carries goals.json and declares a package interface maximum below 12. Refused by the installer's place at interfaces.json (Workflow #455 G-R1 fix round 1, since 0.12.60); since Workflow #463 V1 fix round 3 (0.12.61) below 14, the revision of goals.json version 2, the version the build reads.

goal_variable_unknown.description: A variable entry of goals.json places a name no package of the game root declares as a variable in its control.json, at the entry's name (Workflow #463 V1, since 0.12.61).

goal_version_retired.description: goals.json is version 1 (actingcommand.goals.v1, which 0.12.60 read), which the build reads no more: it reads version 2. At /schema_version; the file is read no further. A version the build does not know yet is malformed there (Workflow #463 V1 fix round 3, since 0.12.61).

variable_conflict.description: A variable several packages of the game root declare with declarations that are not byte-identical (at each declaration in its package's control.json), or whose name an entry of goals.json uses for anything but its placement (at each declaration's name); no variable of that name applies (Workflow #463 V1, since 0.12.61).

variable_out_of_limits.description: A variable name after the game root's 96th, in registry order and then declaration order, at each declaration's name in its package's control.json; it does not apply (Workflow #463 V1, since 0.12.61).

variable_cap_range.description: An integer variable a package reads as a designated effect's cap (max_repeats from session.dispatch.parameter.<name>) declares a max above 1000, at that package's declaration's max; since its fix round 1 also a min below 0, at its min, or a variable of another type read as a cap, at its type (a cap is read from an integer variable only); it does not apply (Workflow #463 V1, since 0.12.61).

variable_irreversible_by_root.description: A variable declared by a package that counts as able to do something irreversible by the whole game root (it provides, unmarked, a capability another package of the root marks irreversible true, or a remedy of its mappings lists one), at the declaration in its package's control.json; no variable of that name applies. Admission refuses variables on a package whose own provides marks the capability (Workflow #463 V1 fix round 1, since 0.12.61).

variable_undeclared.description: A bundle zip whose packs declare variables in their control.json declares a package interface maximum below 14. Refused by the installer's place at interfaces.json (Workflow #463 V1 fix round 1, since 0.12.61).

catalog_side.description: The side of a package's business part in a game root's pack-catalog.json (Workflow #477 PC-1).

consumes.description: The pools the package spends when it runs.

produces.description: The pools the package earns when it runs.

catalog_difference.description: Which of a game root's two files lacks a pool a package consumes or produces (Workflow #477 PC-1).

catalog_lacks.description: A rule of the package in schedule.json names the pool on that side and the package's entry in pack-catalog.json does not list it.

schedule_lacks.description: The package's entry in pack-catalog.json lists the pool on that side and no rule of the package in schedule.json names it there.

catalog_refresh_problem.description: Why actinglab standard-pack catalog refuses a package its refresh names, before anything is written (Workflow #477 PC-2).

package_not_listed.description: The game root's registry (its bundle.json, or the one a resource repository's checkout's packages make) does not hold the package: the cause and the word of standard_pack_problem's package_not_listed (fix round 1: one cause, one word).

package_repeated.description: refresh names the package more than once.

registry_problem.description: Why a prerequisite package is not bound (Workflow #373 NAV-3a).

game_root_missing.description: The root holds no game root of the dependent package's game.

not_listed.description: The game root's bundle.json does not list the package.

navigation_role.description: The part a standard-pack package plays in a run (Workflow #373).

features.description: The feature package that recognises the pages of pages.json.

edge.description: The package of a navigation.json edge (NAV-5).

chain.description: A step of a navigation.json recovery chain (NAV-5).

handler.description: The handler package of a shared interrupt page.

then_run.description: The package a shared interrupt page's then.run names.

navigation_problem.description: Why a standard-pack package cannot play its part in a run (Workflow #373).

server_missing.description: The list names no package of the run's server.

admission_failed.description: The package could not be admitted; the loader's refusal is the cause.

role_ineligible.description: The package's declarations keep it from the part (execution mode, stability termination, post-admission OCR, resource readings or a designated operation).

identity_mismatch.description: Its game, server or resolution is not the run's package's.

prerequisite_declared.description: It declares a prerequisite package of its own.

entry_mismatch.description: Its entry does not hold the page it is named for.

page_set_mismatch.description: The feature package's pages are not exactly the pages of pages.json.

terminal_mismatch.description: An edge's package does not end on the edge's to page (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

application_entry.description: An edge's package is an application entry package (its entry is any), which no edge may be (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

navigation_limit.description: Which navigation bound a run reached (Workflow #373 NAV-5).

locates.description: The 16 full matches of one entry gate.

hops.description: The 16 edges one entry gate may run.

steps.description: The 1000 steps of a run, the next layer's max_steps included.

interrupts.description: The 16 shared interrupt handlings of a run.

config_value_problem.description: Why a configuration value is refused, the reason config_value_invalid carries (Workflow #387).

wrong_type.description: The value is not of the key's type.

out_of_range.description: The value is outside the key's allowed range or words.

section_check.description: The value leaves its section failing the section's whole-section check.

repeated_key.description: The request names the key more than once.

duplicate_id.description: Two trigger items of recovery_ladder.triggers share an id (Workflow #387 D1c), or two rules of agent_wake.rules do (Workflow #432 AGT-1a).

stage_not_allowed.description: A trigger item names no stage, a stage twice, or a stage no item may name (recovery_preparation, resource_fence).

match_missing.description: A trigger item names neither classes nor codes, or an agent_wake rule names no kind, or run_failed with no codes.

code_unknown.description: A code, a code prefix or a ladder class the catalog does not list.

code_retired.description: A code the catalog lists as retired; its replaced_by names the successor.

burst_invalid.description: count and window_ms missing or zero on a stability_warnings item, or present on another.

start_rung_out_of_range.description: A start rung beyond the configured rungs.

rungs_invalid.description: No rung or more than three, an action twice or unknown, or a member of another action.

bound_out_of_range.description: A rung's bound below the device layer's own bound or outside its allowed range.

renewal_cap_exceeded.description: A rung's bound and the hold margin beyond the longest renewal a claim is granted.

claim_ttl_out_of_range.description: A ladder claim's TTL not above the heartbeat bound, beyond the longest renewal, or below the hold margin.

required_missing.description: The agent_wake section leaves out one of its keys; it is whole or absent (Workflow #432 AGT-1a).

kind_unknown.description: An agent_wake rule's kind outside the section's closed list.

instance_unknown.description: An agent_wake rule's instances that are neither * nor a list of configured aliases.

caps_exceed.description: An agent_wake daily cap above the budget, or the budget above the rows host.agent_wake keeps.

dir_reserved.description: agent_wake.body.dir inside a folder the Runtime keeps its own material in.

message_floor.description: A registered channel whose shortest message does not fit agent_wake.summary.max_chars.

daily_summary_shape.description: An agent_wake daily_summary rule that names another kind or codes, leaves out at_minute_of_day or utc_offset_minutes or names one out of range, or whose daily_cap is not 1; or a rule of another kind that names either (Workflow #432 AGT-2b).

backend_kind_unsupported.description: A per-instance touch_backend or capture_backend the instance's kind of device does not have (an emulator has no scrcpy, a handset no nemu_ipc or droidcast_raw), or any backend of a fixture, which has none (#402 HS-1).

backend_pair_required.description: A per-instance touch_backend nemu_ipc beside a capture_backend other than nemu_ipc; Nemu touch works only paired with Nemu capture (#402 HS-1).

backend_switch_not_alone.description: A ConfigureSettings request that names a backend key also names another key, or the backend keys of two instances; one request switches one instance's backends and nothing else (#402 HS-1).

discovery_binding_required.description: A per-instance start_emulator true on an instance whose emulator the Runtime cannot start: one not bound by discovery (a fixture, a handset, an instance bound by its port), as the host knows its instances; since 0.12.39 (#429 R-3), when an instruction sets it and when a start restores it (actingd refuses the same file value earlier as start_emulator_requires_discovery_binding).

registry_unreadable.description: A note, never a refusal: the channel registry is missing or cannot be read.

channel_unknown.description: A note, never a refusal: an agent_wake rule's to that the channel registry does not list.

channel_program_missing.description: A note, never a refusal: a program a registered channel names is not there.

argument_problem.description: What is wrong with one command-line flag or MCP tool argument.

unknown.description: Not a flag of the command or an argument of the tool.

required.description: A required flag or argument is absent.

not_utf8.description: A command-line word that is not UTF-8.

wrong_type.description: Not of the type it must have.

out_of_range.description: A number or a length outside its range (range_min, range_max).

not_recognised.description: Text that is none of the spellings or forms it may take.

conflicting.description: Excludes, or needs, another flag or argument.

unusable.description: Names something that cannot be used: unreadable, not of its kind, or refused.

not_absolute.description: A path that is not absolute where an absolute one is required.

material_state.description: The state of a Runtime material read (RuntimeMaterialReadState).

verified.description: The material was read and verified.

not_provided.description: The Runtime did not provide the material.

missing.description: The material is missing from the store.

integrity_failed.description: The material failed its integrity check.

source_incomplete.description: The material's source record is incomplete.

material_limit.description: Why a Runtime material read stopped short (RuntimeMaterialReadLimit).

pending_eviction.description: The material is about to be evicted.

budget_exceeded.description: The read would exceed its byte budget.

reply_bytes.description: The reply would exceed its byte bound.

run_state.description: The state of a contained run as its ledger events show it (the runtime client's ContainedRunState).

not_found.description: The ledger has no event of the run.

admitted.description: The run was admitted and has not started.

interrupted_unterminated.description: A Runtime start or takeover came after the run's facts without a terminal; uncertain.

resource_targets_rejection_reason.description: Why the Runtime refused a resource-targets document (the contract's ResourceTargetsRejectionReason).

invalid_json.description: The document is not valid JSON.

duplicate_key.description: An object names a key twice.

unknown_field.description: A field the schema does not have.

invalid_type.description: A field of the wrong type.

invalid_value.description: A field value the schema does not allow.

unsupported_schema_version.description: A schema version the Runtime does not read.

duplicate_id.description: A target id, or a target resource in v2, named twice in the document.

unknown_instance.description: The document names an instance the Runtime's projection does not have.

validity_out_of_range.description: valid_until_unix_ms is not after now, or is more than a year ahead, or has passed.

catalog_unavailable.description: No active resource catalog to check against.

unknown_resource.description: A pool the active catalog does not list.

resource_not_observable.description: A pool that is not observed through a resource or inventory fact.

resource_out_of_scope.description: A pool whose scope does not cover the instance.

unknown_task.description: A task the catalog does not list.

task_out_of_scope.description: A task whose scope does not cover the instance.

task_disabled.description: A task an instance override of the instance disables.

unmapped_task.description: No run of the task produces the target's resource.

duplicate_task.description: A task named more than once in the document.

yield_cause.description: Why performance pacing ended a policy run to be rerun (Workflow #385).

wall_ceiling.description: The run reached its wall-clock ceiling after pacing lengthened it.

preempted.description: The run was preempted while it was held.

connectivity_reason.description: Why the operating system's internet connectivity status is unknown (Workflow #369 S6a): the reason host-metrics' network_connectivity gives.

level_unknown.description: The operating system reported its connectivity level as unknown, or a level this build does not know.

query_failed.description: The connectivity query returned an error code (os_error).

query_unsupported.description: The system library has no connectivity query (a Windows before 10 2004).

library_unavailable.description: The system library of the connectivity query could not be loaded (os_error).

unsupported_os.description: This operating system has no connectivity query.

pacing_cause.description: Why a pacing stage changed (Workflow #385 PERF section 11).

responsiveness.description: The tracked responsiveness moved the stage.

pressure.description: A pressure's stage-one floor began or ended.

idle_recovery.description: Without any evidence, the tracked value recovered toward the top.

pacing_mode.description: How far performance pacing takes effect (Workflow #385 PERF section 10.3): every release ships observe; pace and full are a person's configuration.

observe.description: Measure and record only; nothing takes effect.

pace.description: Lengthen intervals and deadlines, never pause.

full.description: Pacing and proportional pauses, with the learning period.

probe_kind.description: A host probe of the shadow measurement (Workflow #385 PERF section 3.2).

timer.description: Repeated short sleeps; their oversleep is the ready queue's delay.

message.description: A posted message's delay until its thread handles it.

signal_kind.description: A scored signal of the shadow measurement (Workflow #385 PERF section 3.2).

capture_acquire.description: One frame's acquisition from the capture backend.

remedy_source.description: The source that decided a remedy's allowed capabilities or a parameter's value, in the order the Runtime consults them (Workflow #411 B15).

target.description: The instance's target record session.remedy.choices (instance, server or game scope), written by a person or an agent.

configuration.description: The configuration rows in effect for the instance: scheduling.remedy.choices, or the instance's own list.

package.description: The package's declared default: the mapping's remedy default or the provider's parameter default.

remedy_problem.description: Why a remedy cannot be used, or why a blocked task stopped for a person (Workflow #411 B15).

no_choice.description: No target record, configuration row or package default names the need.

choice_none.description: The deciding source says no remedy for the need (a none row).

choice_invalid.description: A choice names a capability the remedy does not list or leaves nothing allowed, or a configuration row names a need or capability no bound package declares.

parameter_invalid.description: A chosen parameter is not declared by the provider, or its value is not one of the provider's options.

capability_unbound.description: No catalog task on the instance is bound to a package that provides the capability.

cycle.description: The remedy's providers lie on a cycle of blocked and provider tasks or packages, or are already in the chain.

parameters_mismatch.description: Providers of one capability declare different parameters.

provider_unavailable.description: Every provider is paused, its package suspended, or it is disabled for the instance by an override or a placement refusal.

round_limit.description: A layer used scheduling.remedy.max_per_round requests and the block remained.

depth_limit.description: A provider at the third layer of the chain ended blocked again.

capability_unprovided.description: No package of the game root provides the capability (package bundle and standard-pack check).

resource_verify_step.description: The steps of actinglab resource verify, in the order they run (Workflow #411 RV-1).

tools.description: The build that runs: its compiled head, its executable's SHA-256 and the build manifest beside it.

checkout.description: The precondition: the top of the work tree, HEAD, --commit, --base and the commit's clean tree.

declarations.description: The declaration selection built from Git, read by the reader of resource validate.

pins.description: The committed package_digest and sha256 members.

admission.description: The layout of packs/ and every pack admitted as package preflight admits it, with its identity.

format.description: package fmt --check of every pack directory.

bundle.description: The bundle, its index and copies, its zip, the read-back and the installed root.

git_command.description: The read-only git command that failed (Workflow #411 RV-1).

rev_parse.description: git rev-parse (the top level, HEAD, its tree, the base).

ls_files.description: git ls-files (the index with its blobs, or a pathspec selection).

diff.description: git diff --no-renames --name-status -z, or a status in its answer other than A, D, M or T.

checkout_problem.description: Why a checkout is not the commit to verify (Workflow #411 RV-1).

not_top_level.description: The path given is not the top of its Git work tree.

head_not_commit.description: HEAD names no commit or no tree.

commit_mismatch.description: The commit given is not HEAD.

dirty_problem.description: How a checkout differs from its commit's tree (Workflow #411 RV-1).

tracked_change.description: git status reports a changed, staged, deleted or unmerged tracked file.

untracked.description: An untracked file lies anywhere in the work tree.

ignored_in_read_path.description: An ignored file lies under packs/, regression/ or is a root input.

blob_mismatch.description: A file the command reads does not hash, without filters, to its committed blob, or is missing.

base_problem.description: Why a base revision is refused (Workflow #411 RV-1).

not_ancestor.description: The commit is not an ancestor of HEAD.

tools_problem.description: What the build manifest beside the executable does not confirm (Workflow #411 RV-1).

executable_sha256.description: Its actinglab.exe entry names other bytes than the executable's, or it has none; or the executable does not read.

commit.description: Its commit_sha is not the head the build was compiled from.

manifest_invalid.description: It does not read as a build manifest with commit_sha and files.

layout_problem.description: Which rule of a bundle source a repository breaks (Workflow #411 RV-1).

packs_missing.description: packs/ is missing or holds no pack directory.

packs_entry_invalid.description: packs/ holds an entry that is neither a pack directory nor packs/README.md.

pack_name_mismatch.description: The pack's control declares another package_id than its directory name.

pack_game_mismatch.description: The pack declares another game than applications.json.

pack_server_undeclared.description: The pack's server is not a server of applications.json.

bundle_problem.description: How a written bundle differs from its source (Workflow #411 RV-1).

index_schema.description: bundle.json is no bundle v4 index.

maintenance_differs.description: The index's maintenance is not maintenance.json's.

applications_differs.description: The bundled applications.json differs from the source's bytes, the index's game from its game, or the game is no directory name.

source_differs.description: The index's source is not the repository given at HEAD.

pack_list_differs.description: The indexed packs are not the pack directories of packs/, or an indexed pack's path, server or entry task differs from its source.

pack_copy_differs.description: A bundled pack does not hold its source's files, byte for byte.

pack_counts_differ.description: An indexed pack's file_count or byte_count is not its copy's.

default_package_unmatched.description: A server's default_package_id names not exactly one bundled pack of that server.

root_file_differs.description: The bundle root holds other entries than applications.json, bundle.json, packs and the root files given, or a root file differs from its source.

root_files_unread.description: standard-pack check of the installed root read other root files than bundle.json and the root files given, or another number of packs.

readback_problem.description: How a written zip reads back (Workflow #411 RV-1).

entry_set_differs.description: The zip reads back as another set of entries.

bytes_differ.description: An entry reads back as other bytes.

interfaces_differs.description: interfaces.json does not declare what was written.

fact_time_problem.description: Why a fact_time_reached predicate's fact gives no time (Workflow #405).

missing.description: No fact with this key exists in the predicate's scope.

stale.description: The fact was observed longer ago than the predicate's max_age_ms.

expired.description: The fact is past its own expiry.

not_a_time.description: The fact's value is not a timestamp_ms value.

policy_input.description: Which input of a policy evaluation a check refused (ISO-PE, #419).

completed_window.description: The activity window a pair's settled run completed.

policy_input_problem.description: Why a check refused a policy evaluation input (ISO-PE, #419).

observed_after_evaluation.description: The input was observed later than the evaluation's time.

unknown_reference.description: The input names a task, an instance or a pool the evaluation does not know.

value_invalid.description: The input's metadata or value breaks a rule.

decision_state.description: The state of a scheduling decision, as a dispatch decision record gives it for each candidate it lists (Workflow #411 A26).

eligible.description: Nothing deferred or blocked the candidate this round.

deferred.description: Something holds the candidate back for now; a later round may run it.

blocked.description: The candidate cannot run until its inputs change.

selected.description: The candidate was dispatched this round.

eligibility.description: The eligibility of a scheduling decision, what its trigger and feedback stop decided, as a dispatch decision record gives it for each candidate it lists (Workflow #411 A26).

true.description: The trigger passed and the feedback stop did not fire.

false.description: Not eligible: the trigger is false, the feedback stop fired, or the scope matches no instance.

unknown.description: Not decided: a predicate is unknown, or the candidate was settled before its trigger was read.

program_problem.description: Which rule of a contained task's program refused it at admission (Workflow #411 A39).

operations_empty.description: The task declares no operation, which only a zero-input fields task of task schema 0.8 or 0.9 without recovery may (contracts/ocr-fields.md).

wait_member_refused.description: A wait step (#411 B36/B19, A35-S3) declares a member it never takes: click, application, select, guard, unguarded_trusted_coordinate, retryable, max_attempts, retry_interval_ms, post_delay_ms, on_error, input_recheck, observation_window, on_guard_refused, or a wait page of its own (expect_after.wait_page).

wait_from_invalid.description: A wait step's from is not one page of the package (any, or a page that resolves to none or to several), or is a target page or an error page.

wait_destination_missing.description: A wait step declares no destination (to or expect_after).

wait_max_invalid.description: A wait step's max_ms or a wait page's max_ms is outside 1..=1800000; Workflow #407 LOAD-2 (since 0.12.37): or an expect_after.loading.max_ms.

wait_designated.description: A wait step is a designated operation or a member of a designated effect set.

wait_timeout_unmapped.description: A wait step's on_timeout names no mapping of the task's scheduling outcome that lists the step's from page.

wait_timeout_not_busy.description: The mapping a wait step's on_timeout names does not declare busy (#411 B37).

wait_page_invalid.description: A confirmation's wait page (expect_after.wait_page.page_id) is not one page of the package, or is a destination of its operation or an error page. Workflow #407 LOAD-2 (since 0.12.37): a step plan, which admits a wait page, refuses one that is not one page of the package with it.

store_operation_invalid.description: STORE-FG-1 (since 0.12.29): a store operation of control.json store_update names no operation of the task, one whose effect is no click that draws a tap (point, rect, specific_rect, target, target_center, offset), one whose from is not one page of the package, or one without a guard on its from page (no guard, or unguarded_trusted_coordinate), whose tap could land on a frame where the page and its proof were not checked; json_pointer /store_update/store_operations/<i>/operation.

store_proof_invalid.description: STORE-FG-1 (since 0.12.29): a proof target of a store operation is no OCR target of the pack with an expected text, or does not stand directly in the required list of the operation's from page; json_pointer /store_update/store_operations/<i>/proof/<j>.

store_way_back_missing.description: STORE-FG-1 (since 0.12.29): a package that declares store_update declares no application operation that launches or restarts the assigned application; json_pointer /store_update.

expect_targets_overlap.description: ACT-4 (since 0.12.37): a target of an operation's expect_after stands in both target_present and target_gone, or twice in one of them; json_pointer /operations/<i>/expect_after/<list>/<j>, the later entry.

expect_target_unknown.description: ACT-4 (since 0.12.37): an entry of an operation's expect_after.target_present or target_gone names no target of the package's recognition pack; json_pointer /operations/<i>/expect_after/<list>/<j>.

expect_target_kind.description: ACT-4 (since 0.12.37): an entry of an operation's expect_after.target_present or target_gone names a target that is not judged on one frame: no template or colour target (located text, a value test, a check, an OCR, model or digest target), or one under target consensus; json_pointer /operations/<i>/expect_after/<list>/<j>.

expect_target_unreachable.description: ACT-4 (since 0.12.37): an entry of an operation's expect_after.target_present or target_gone names a target that stands in the rules (required, any_of, optional, forbidden) of neither the operation's from page nor one of its destinations, directly or as a member of a check there; json_pointer /operations/<i>/expect_after/<list>/<j>.

loading_conflict.description: Workflow #407 LOAD-2 (since 0.12.37): an operation's expect_after.loading is "off" beside a wait page (json_pointer /operations/<i>/expect_after/loading), or names max_ms beside a wait page's max_ms, which is the confirmation's allowance already (json_pointer /operations/<i>/expect_after/loading/max_ms).

loading_except_unknown.description: Workflow #407 LOAD-2 (since 0.12.37): an entry of an operation's expect_after.loading.except names no loading page the package compiled from its loading copy, or one an earlier entry names; json_pointer /operations/<i>/expect_after/loading/except/<j>.

loading_page_invalid.description: Workflow #407 LOAD-2 (since 0.12.37): an entry of an operation's expect_after.loading.add is not one page of the package or repeats an earlier one, or, in a page graph, is the operation's from page, one of its destinations or an error page (a step plan refuses its own pages with contained_task_linear_invalid, reason=loading_page); json_pointer /operations/<i>/expect_after/loading/add/<j>.

loading_max_missing.description: Workflow #407 LOAD-4 (since 0.12.38): an operation's confirmation has loading pages (expect_after.loading.add) and no limit is named for them: no expect_after.loading.max_ms, no wait page and no loading copy in the package, in a page graph and in a step plan; json_pointer /operations/<i>/expect_after/loading.
