lab_target_type.description: What kind of id a Lab operation's target is (#411 A37).

element_id.description: The element id of an observation: the complete elements[].id.

target_id.description: The id of a recognition target in the package's recognition pack.

lab_operation_end.description: How a Lab operation that ran an operation its package declares ended (Workflow #412 B-3; ledger revision 4 row LR-10).

confirmed.description: The operation's step completed on its confirmed page.

run_completed.description: The step ended the package's run as a success, on a page and an outcome key.

passed_over.description: The guard refused the input and the operation was passed over.

recovery_requested.description: The operation's failure asked for recovery, which the Lab does not run.

lab_operation_problem.description: Why the Lab cannot run an operation its package declares, as the kernel runs it (Workflow #412 B-3).

application_effect.description: The operation is an application effect.

select_step.description: The operation is a select step: it needs a policy, a fact snapshot and possibly a scan.

linear_steps.description: The package runs linear_steps, another step loop.

chosen_identity.description: The operation reads the identity an earlier select step of the same run chose.

wait.description: The operation is a wait step: it makes no input and waits on its page for its destinations, on the run's budget clock (Workflow #411 B36, B19).

expected_shape.description: The shape a declaration member must have (Workflow #411 B28).

array_of_arrays.description: An array whose every element is an array: a page rule's any_of, a list of groups of target ids (contracts/resource-declarations.md).

install_refusal.description: Why an installer command refused, or failed without leaving an unfinished operation (contracts/install-cli.md, "Outcome codes").

not_single_location.description: The root is no single-location root: runtime\BUILD-MANIFEST.json is not a file.

layout_ab_unsupported.description: The root holds install\active.json (path): an A/B installation, which acsetup installs, not actingctl install.

not_adopted.description: install\state.json is missing: run actingctl install adopt first.

state_invalid.description: install\state.json, install\current.json or an operation journal is not what this build writes (path).

operation_unfinished.description: Another installer operation is unfinished (install\current.json, install_operation_id): every other mutating command refuses until install resume or install undo ends it.

foreign_part.description: A staging part (.part) of another operation lies in the root (path); Tools never removes it.

writer_lock_failed.description: install\writer.lock could not be taken within install.lock_wait_ms.

release_check_failed.description: A release folder failed its checks; release_checks lists every failed check.

live_build_invalid.description: The live runtime\ and tools\ manifests are unreadable or name different commits.

live_build_modified.description: A file that a live manifest lists differs from it or is missing (count, files).

build_not_kept.description: The named build is not kept under install\builds.

build_invalid.description: The kept build does not verify against its own manifests (commit_sha, path).

config_unreadable.description: The root's actingd.config.json, or the standard-pack root it names, cannot be read or is not JSON.

install_section_invalid.description: The configuration's install section breaks its rules (config_value_invalid is the link).

config_refused_by_target.description: check-config of the build that will run refused the configuration: the live one for an update or rollback, the candidate for a configuration commit (INST-3); its outcome is the link.

check_config_unanswered.description: check-config of a build could not be run or answered no report, or was still running at install.child.check_config_timeout_ms: then it is left running (pid, config_key the key) and has no cause link.

config_base_changed.description: The configuration candidate was built on a live file that has changed since (INST-3).

lab_options_locked.description: config set may not write a Lab option (config_key); only config lab-options writes them (INST-3).

catalog_plan_unexpected.description: The candidate changes the catalog plan without a policy write (INST-3).

runtime_running.description: An actingcommand-actingd.exe runs under the root.

owner_lock_held.description: The state root's owner lock is held (a Runtime, ledger-maintenance or unlock-owner).

processes_unreadable.description: The running state could not be read: the processes under the root, or the owner journal of the configuration's state root.

running_image_blocks.description: A running process's image under the root would change and may not be renamed aside (path, pid): any image but actingctl.exe, and adb.exe always.

interface_edge.description: An interface edge failed; the result's edges list it.

ledger_verify_failed.description: The target build's ledger-maintenance verify did not pass, or was still running at install.child.ledger_verify_timeout_ms (pid, config_key the key): it is left running and the operation stays unfinished, as the caused_by link of install_operation_interrupted.

ledger_head_unreadable.description: The ledger head (S0) could not be read with the live build's actingledger (its bounded head read), or the read was still running at install.child.ledger_read_timeout_ms: then it is left running (pid, config_key the key).

plan_changed.description: The plan recomputed under the writer lock differs from the plan_id the apply was given: something changed since the plan.

rollback_gate_failed.description: The rollback gate failed (rollback_gate_parts); ledger_sequence is the first sequence the target's own reader refused, as precisely as the reader allows; pid and config_key name a reader read left running at install.child.ledger_read_timeout_ms. Only a forward fix remains.

guard_failed.description: A guard failed or could not be evaluated and was not acknowledged with --ack-guard (install_guards; INST-2).

runtime_start_failed.description: The installer's start ended without a ready Runtime (INST-2): the start path's own code is the link (exited_during_startup, or start_timeout with its timeout_ms, after which the process is left running).

pack_invalid.description: A bundle zip failed the placement checks (game; INST-4). Since 0.12.60 (Workflow #453 S7) also the Lab's rescue module's vision check, when the Tools' standard-pack check of a game root below standard_packs.root gave no models (game, path the game root; its outcome or the child's failure as the cause, or timeout_ms when it was ended at its bound of 300 s, or at the row's limit when less of that was left, or not run when none was: timeout_ms then the row's limit, 900 s).

pack_binding_broken.description: A package the configuration binds is not in the new bundle (package_id; INST-4).

pack_maintenance_drift.description: A server's maintenance role moves to another package while an instance binds the old one (package_id; INST-4).

instances_not_idle.description: A hot placement found the affected instances not idle in time (aliases); they stay paused (INST-4). The Lab's rescue module's place hands its own pauses back at once, since nothing changed on disk yet (Workflow #434 LAB-3 fix 1, since 0.12.48).

instance_invalid.description: An instance add or remove was refused (alias; INST-5).

runtime_not_running.description: No Runtime answers on the root's state root where the command needs one: update apply --stop (the hold and its S0 are taken from the running Runtime), release-hold, or the release of a composite's hold (INST-2). alias names the instance whose resume failed, the client's failure is the caused_by link.

runtime_stop_failed.description: The hold or the formal close did not complete (INST-2): a pause or the request-shutdown was refused or did not answer, its wait passed install.stop.shutdown_wait_ms (nothing is killed), or after the pauses the status did not show exactly the expected ones (count and aliases the instances that differ). The hold's pauses stay; release-hold lifts them.

post_check_failed.description: A fail-class post-start check failed (count the failed checks; the result's post_check lists them) and the automatic rollback could not run: the new Runtime did not stop within install.stop.shutdown_wait_ms (nothing is killed), or the command was a start or a rollback of its own (INST-2). The hold stays.

deploy_rolled_back.description: A composite update rolled back by itself, between the new start and the resume (Alice's decision 74 A): a fail-class post-start check failed or the new start ended (count the failed checks; the result's failed_checks names them), the rollback gate toward the previous build passed, the operation's file steps were reversed and the previous build started (commit_sha). When the previous build's checks passed its hold was released and scheduling resumed; the command still reports this refusal.

slot_occupied.description: A/B (design 2.9): the slot to prepare or replace is in use (an exclusive slot lock refused, a process imaged under it, or its rename refused with OS error 5 or 32); the refusal lists the occupants {pid, image, kind, pinned_selection?}, needs_person close_slot_occupants. Nothing changed. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

slot_is_active.description: A/B (design 2.9): the slot named for preparation is the active one, which is never prepared. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

slot_unrecognised.description: A/B (design 2.9): the target or active slot has no SLOT.json, or it cannot be read or does not match; needs_person inspect_slot. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

slot_not_clean.description: A/B (design 2.9): the target slot is cleanup_failed with its folder still present; needs_person remove_unlisted_files, next clean. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

previous_slot_unconfirmed.description: A/B (design 2.9, Alice's ruling 131): the target slot still holds the previous selection and the active selection's health confirmation is not complete; values missing name the half; next follows design 3.15. Nothing changed. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

platform_tools_changed.description: A/B (design 2.2): the candidate Tools carry platform-tools whose bytes differ from the root's tools\platform-tools; changing adb is a planned event and Tools never stops the adb server. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

state_selection_mismatch.description: A/B (design 2.10): install\state.json mirrors another selection than install\active.json; plan refuses, resume rewrites the mirror. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

selection_changed_externally.description: A/B (design 3.3): at commit_selection the pointer was neither the baseline nor the candidate: another writer replaced it. The operation ends refused after its changes (outcome_kind refused_after_change), the deployment pause kept; next names only start and undo --ack-guard selection_external. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

selection_commit_lost.description: A/B (design 3.6): the journal records the commit but install\active.json is the baseline again after the start began; needs_person selection_commit_lost. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

selection_commit_failed.description: A/B (design 3.5): the pointer rename kept failing with OS error 5 or 32 until install.lock_wait_ms; the cause link of install_operation_interrupted, the pointer still the baseline. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

not_same_volume.description: A/B (design 3.5): a part folder, install\selections\ or the pointer's part is not on the volume of the slots and install\active.json (a rename would fail with OS error 17). (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

reparse_point.description: A/B (design 3.5): the path to a slot, a part or the pointer passes a reparse point or link. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

rollback_material_unavailable.description: A/B (design 3.1, 3.8, 3.14 constraint 4): the slot of state.previous is cleaned or does not verify; values are status rollback.material; next prepare --to-selection while the builds are kept, else needs_person restage_previous_build. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

operation_attempt_running.description: Design 3.11: another process runs an attempt of this operation (its attempt lock is held), or a background attempt is being handed over; values attempt_phase running or handover. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

operation_id_unavailable.description: Design 3.11: no operation id could be minted: the attempt lock file of every millisecond tried (up to 1000) already exists. Nothing opened. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

attempt_record_exists.description: Design 3.11: an attempt or spawn record's final name already exists when its first write is renamed in; the record is not overwritten. After a change on disk the attempt ends install_operation_interrupted with this refusal as its link. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

detach_spawn_failed.description: Design 3.11: the background child could not be spawned; the parent ends the journal with this refusal and retires install\current.json. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

detach_identity_mismatch.description: Design 3.11 step 5: a background child does not match its attempt (current.json, the attempt lock, the latest attempt, attempts[n].argv and verb, an unfinished journal); only its attempt record says so, unless it is the first attempt of an operation with no change yet, whose journal ends refused with it. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

client_ref_unknown.description: Design 3.11: install status --client-ref names no operation; the person sees the result as unconfirmed, never as a success. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

ui_confirmation_stale.description: Design 3.14: install clean --ui-confirmed names a selection that is not the active one; nothing is written. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

clean_irreversible.description: Design 3.14: an undo of a clean operation; a clean is never undone, resume finishes it. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

entry_modified.description: Design 6.2: a fixed entry's bytes differ from state.entries; plan refuses. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

config_candidate_pending.description: Design 4.3: an update or rollback while install\candidate\ holds an uncommitted configuration candidate; commit or discard it first. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

convert_layout_unrecognised.description: Design 5.7: a convert_check failed; the refusal carries convert_checks with each check's values and nothing changed. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

convert_rolled_back.description: Design 5.6: a conversion with --start undid itself after a fail-class post-start check, before any health confirmation (outcome_kind rolled_back); loud, never a success. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

state_root_mismatch.description: Design 5.2 state_root_consistent: the configured state root is missing or differs from the running Runtime's, or S0's ledger head cannot be read. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

state_root_placeholder.description: Design 5.2 state_root_consistent: the configured state root's last name matches *.placeholder-*. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

layout_single_convert_first.description: Design 5.8 step 6: after the single-location update and rollback code is removed, a single-location root answers this: convert it first. (R-15b, since 0.12.35)

hold_not_owned.description: The Lab's rescue module hands back only its own hold (contracts/lab-two-entries.md section 5): release-hold of a reason no journal of the module recorded in its pause step, down with a reason an instance already shows (aliases), or a release that found the reason on an instance at another revision or owner epoch than the module recorded (aliases, left as they are). hold_reason names the reason. Nothing is paused or resumed by the refusal; another party's pause is never touched. (Workflow #434 LAB-3 fix 1, since 0.12.48)

mcp_server_not_in_build.description: The Lab's rescue module's mcp plan, the plan of the MCP entry's second generation, found no actinglab-mcp.exe in the manifests of the installed build, neither in its runtime\ nor in its tools\ (commit_sha the build, path the last place looked). It names no program that does not exist and no other program; every build before the server is packaged answers this. The refusal carries the tunables, as every refusal of the plan after its configuration read does. (Workflow #434 LAB-5G5b, since 0.12.57)

emulator_discovery_failed.description: The Lab's rescue module's emulators got no completed discovery from the live build's actingd discover of the root's configuration (contracts/emulator-control.md, "Offline instance discovery"): actingd refused (its outcome is the caused_by link: instance_discovery_unavailable, mumu_manager_version_unsupported, invalid_arguments, or a configuration refusal of check-config's), printed no discover report (a build before it, or a crash: foreign_other_error with the exit code and stderr), did not run, or was still running at its bound of 60 s and was ended there (timeout_ms the bound, no cause link; it is read only, so ending it loses nothing, and no actingd of the root is left running). Nothing was written. (Workflow #453 S10, since 0.12.59)

vision_root_unresolved.description: The Lab's rescue module's vision check (or vision place) got the live build's actingd vision check refusal of the root's configuration or of the vision root it names (contracts/vision-model-folders.md, "The manifest"): a refusal at a stage, which actingd names only where it loads the configuration (config_load), assembles its vision section (config_assemble) and resolves the vision root (config_vision); fix 2: decided by that stage, not by what the refusal is not. Its outcome is the caused_by link, vision_root_unavailable or vision_root_in_program_slot for a vision root that does not resolve or whose models folder cannot be listed, vision_config_invalid for a vision section that breaks its rules or has no manifest, or a refusal of the configuration file at stage config_load. Only vision check and (Workflow #453 S9, since 0.12.60) vision place answer it, by the same rule from the same child, and only when a root really is not resolved (for vision place also a vision root that does not exist yet: the row never creates one); every other failure of the child is vision_report_unanswered. Nothing was written. (Workflow #453 S7, since 0.12.60; fix 1, fix 2)

vision_report_unanswered.description: The Lab's rescue module's vision manifest or vision check got no usable report from the live build's actingd vision (contracts/vision-model-folders.md, "The manifest"): it printed none (a build before the subcommand, or a crash: foreign_other_error with the exit code and stderr), refused with no stage (fix 2: every refusal but vision_root_unresolved's: its own installation check or slot lock, --install-root, its command line (invalid_arguments, among them a --model no model folder may be named, or more than 64 of them) or its own registry (serialization_failed)), each its outcome as the caused_by link, printed a check report without its lists (foreign_data_error), did not run (the OS failure), or was still running when its bound ran out and was ended there, or for vision check found no time left of the row's limit and was not run (timeout_ms the bound that ran out: 30 s for vision manifest, 160 s for vision check, or the vision check row's limit of 900 s when that ran out first; no cause link; it is read only, so ending it loses nothing). It says nothing about the vision root. Nothing was written. (Workflow #453 S7 fix 1, since 0.12.60) The rescue module's vision place answers it too, from the same child before anything is written (Workflow #453 S9, since 0.12.60), and also for a check report that names a manifest file without a plain place, a size and a SHA-256 (foreign_data_error): no file is placed that cannot be verified.

root_not_empty.description: The Lab's rescue module's new builds a fresh root only into a folder that is absent or empty (contracts/install-cli.md, "Fresh root"): its new_root exists and is not an empty folder (a file there counts as not empty; a folder that cannot be listed is refused the same way, the operating system's failure as the caused_by link). path names it. When the folder holds an unfinished operation of new, install_operation_id names it and next names the ways to continue or undo it. Nothing was written. (Workflow #453 S4, since 0.12.60)

state_root_not_empty.description: The Lab's rescue module's new creates the state root's folder empty and refuses a state root (its new_state_root, or the new root's state folder) that exists and is not an empty folder (a file there counts as not empty; a folder that cannot be listed is refused the same way, the operating system's failure as the caused_by link): another installation's ledger is never taken over by a fresh root. path names it. Nothing was written. (Workflow #453 S4, since 0.12.60)

vision_source_invalid.description: A file the Lab's rescue module's vision place would place does not hold its pin, the size and SHA-256 the installed build's manifest gives it (contracts/install-cli.md, "The Lab's rescue module"): before anything is written, the file below the --from folder at the manifest's place is missing, of another size or of another SHA-256, or cannot be read (the OS failure as the caused_by link), or the --from folder does not resolve to a folder; path names it, and the answer's source names its place, its state and its pin. During the operation, the copy of such a file or the placed file that does not hold the pin is this refusal as the cause of install_operation_interrupted (path that copy or file): resume or undo. A file below --from the manifest does not name is never read or copied. (Workflow #453 S9, since 0.12.60)

state_root_claim_unanswered.description: The Lab's rescue module's state-root claim got no report from the live build's actingd claim-state-root (contracts/state-root-installation.md, "Handing a state root over"): it did not run (the child's failure as the caused_by link), printed no report (a build before 0.12.60 refuses the subcommand as a start's arguments: foreign_other_error with the exit code and stderr), or was still running at install.child.check_config_timeout_ms and was left running (pid and config_key). path is the state root. Whether actingd handed the state root over is then not known: run the row again once no actingd runs; a hand-over that was done answers that nothing changed. (Workflow #453 S12, since 0.12.60)

place_authorization_missing.description: The Lab's rescue module's place of a plan that changes something names no authorization: --authorization is absent or blank (contracts/install-cli.md, "The authorization a placement names"). plan_id and game name the plan. Only --plan and a plan that changes nothing need none; the tool records a reference and grants nothing, so it never supplies one. Refused after the plan and before the hold: nothing was paused or written, no journal begun. (Workflow #463 S3-2, since 0.12.64)

place_enables_mismatch.description: The Lab's rescue module's place: the packages --enables names are not exactly the plan's enters, the packages the placement makes enter scheduling (a name missing, a name too many, or one given twice; --enables given when nothing enters). The answer's expected (enters) and given (--enables), each sorted, say which; plan_id and game name the plan. Compared after the authorization is found. Refused before the hold: nothing was paused or written, no journal begun. (Workflow #463 S3-2, since 0.12.64)

place_enables_unknown.description: The Lab's rescue module's place: the plan answers no enters because it could not read the zip's side (its schedule.json, refused by the contract crate's reader or by the composer's reference check), so the packages the placement would enable cannot be named and no --enables can match them; the answer carries the plan's schedule_changes beside the outcome, whose unread names that refusal (standard_pack_root_invalid at the file), and plan_id and game name the plan. A zip whose other root files the reader refuses is refused pack_invalid earlier, in the plan; an installed game root that cannot be read refuses nothing (a placement is how it is repaired). Refused before the hold: nothing was paused or written, no journal begun. (Workflow #463 S3-2, since 0.12.64)

install_caveat.description: What an installer command noted while its work went on (contracts/install-cli.md, "Outcome codes").

release_unconfirmed.description: A release folder was checked without a release-facts file: the files match SHA256SUMS and their manifests, but the tag and the published asset digests were not checked.

mcp_clients_on_previous_build.description: An update or rollback renamed running actingctl images aside (MCP servers, reads) that keep running on the previous build (count); their clients reconnect to use the new build.

pack_declaration_unknown.description: A placed game root's package interface is not known (adopted roots keep no interfaces.json), so the package edge could not be checked for it (game).

post_check_mismatch.description: A post-check after an installer start did not match (count); the Runtime stays up and the hold stays (INST-2).

restart_required.description: A configuration was committed while the Runtime runs: it takes effect at the next start, a watchdog restart after a crash included (INST-3).

config_overridden_by_instruction.description: A configuration key written to the candidate is overridden by a run-time instruction (config_key; INST-3).

pack_restart_needed.description: A placement changes the reading keys of a bound recognition package, which the Runtime reads only at start (package_id; INST-4).

pack_full_check_skipped.description: No actinglab.exe under the root's tools\, so a placed game root got the Runtime reader's check only (path; INST-4).

open_time_from_other_build.description: The rollback gate's open-time part found no ledger open of the target build on this root (the operation journals attribute each start log to the build live at its start), so it judged the newest open of another build (commit_sha the target, path the start log used).

check_config_without_install_root.description: The target build's check-config does not take --install-root (a build before actingd-config revision 17, or one that refused the option), so it ran without it from the kept build's folder, which it judged as the install root (its adb and default vision root); only the outcome's category counts (commit_sha the target, path its actingd).

start_stalled.description: The installer's start looks stalled (INST-2, the stall rule's detection): its log did not grow for install.start.stall_after_ms, or the starting Runtime read more than install.start.stall_read_bytes before it was ready (path the log). Nothing is killed; ending a process is the person's decision.

stop_terminal_unconfirmed.description: The formal close completed (the owner record closed and the process exited), but the closed start's terminal outcome was not runtime_stopped, or no start log of the closed Runtime was found (path the log when one was read; INST-2).

runs_not_continued.description: The hold's drain stopped runs in flight at their next checkpoint after install.stop.drain_timeout_ms (count): they are not continued mid-run; after the release the Runtime evaluates their tasks again from their start (INST-2, Alice's decision 75 of 10-27; mid-run continuation is a later slice).

guard_failed.description: In the Lab's rescue module a guard failed or was not evaluated and the operation went on (contracts/lab-two-entries.md section 6: guards report, never refuse); install_guards names the guards, and the answer and the journal keep their rows. actingctl install refuses the same rows with install_refusal guard_failed instead. (Workflow #434 LAB-3, since 0.12.48)

hold_ownership_unconfirmed.description: The Lab's rescue module could not read whether a hold is its own (contracts/lab-two-entries.md section 5): the reason does not parse, or the root or its operations folder cannot be read. The answer's next leaves that release-hold out, as for a hold the module does not own, and this note says why; operation is install_release_hold, hold_reason names the reason when it parses, and the read failure is the caused_by link. Nothing is paused or resumed. (Workflow #434 LAB-3 fix 3, since 0.12.48)

mcp_entry_not_placed.description: The Lab's rescue module's mcp config gave the registration snippet of the MCP entry's second generation, whose program is not placed in the root (path the program the snippet names, <root>\mcp-entry\g2\actingcommand-mcp-entry-g2.exe): a client registered with it cannot start it until it is placed there. The snippet is given all the same; nothing is written. (Workflow #434 LAB-5G5b, since 0.12.57)

vision_incomplete.description: The Lab's rescue module's vision check found that the root's vision root does not hold what it must (contracts/vision-model-folders.md, "The manifest"): count is the manifest files whose state is not ok (missing, sha256_mismatch, unreadable) and the models, of the manifest and of the root's installed packs, each pair of model_ref and model_sha256 once, whose folder is missing, invalid or of another identity. The answer lists each; nothing was written, and placing the files is another command's. As the top of the answer, exit 0. (Workflow #453 S7, since 0.12.60)

fingerprints_discontinuous.description: The Lab's rescue module's state-root claim replaced a record of another installation, or one that could not be read (contracts/state-root-installation.md, "Handing a state root over"): the ledger's records that carry fingerprints were made with the salt of the configuration that wrote them, and the command cannot know whether this configuration's salt is the same, so a fingerprint recorded before the hand-over may not match one made after it. path is the kept old record, installation.json.old-<ms>: the one set aside now, or (fix round 1) when a record was written while the state root already held kept old records (a hand-over that was interrupted between setting the old record aside and placing the new one, or whose put-back failed), the newest of them. The hand-over is done; the ledger's records stay as they are. A note under install_command_done. (Workflow #453 S12, since 0.12.60)

undo_enters_scheduling.description: The Lab's rescue module's undo of a pack_place operation lets packages enter scheduling, or take a supporting role, again (contracts/install-cli.md, "The packages the undo of a placement makes enter or leave scheduling"): the enters of the answer's schedule_changes, computed before the undo's first step by the placement plan's own judgement from the game root as it is to the game root as the undo leaves it, is not empty. names lists those package ids, sorted; game names the placement's game; operation is install_undo. A note under install_command_done of the undo done, and of its plan form (--plan), which writes nothing. Fix round 1: an undo run again after it stopped, its plan form and op resume of an undo that ended its steps compute nothing again (the game root is then half undone): their enters is the one the undo record holds. The undo is not refused and asks for no authorization (whether it must is the owner's to rule and is open); the warning says what the person did not see otherwise. Exit 0. (Workflow #463 S3-18, since 0.12.69)

undo_scheduling_unknown.description: The Lab's rescue module's undo of a pack_place operation could not read the game root as the undo leaves it (a root file the contract crate's reader refuses, a schedule.json the reader or the composer's reference check refuses, a file that cannot be read or is beyond the bound, a journal whose game root this build cannot read), so its schedule_changes carries packages and unread and none of the three lists: what the undo changes of scheduling is not known. The failure of that side, unread's undone entry, is the caused_by link; game names the placement's game when known; operation is install_undo. A note under install_command_done of the undo done, and of its plan form; the undo is not refused and goes on as before. Fix round 1: an undo run again after it stopped, its plan form and op resume of an undo that ended its steps answer it from the undo record, whose two lists are null, with no caused_by link (the record keeps no failure; the first run's answer carried it). Exit 0. (Workflow #463 S3-18, since 0.12.69)
